heading: Four stages.
why: Layout, content and behavior are agreed on paper first, so the build is not redone.

steps.title: Listen
steps.text: We map requirements, goals and timelines up front.

steps.title: Draft
steps.text: You review drawings of every key page before we build.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: We code the site and test it on real devices.

steps.title: Launch
steps.text: We go live, train your team and stay on for the first weeks.
